news.contents: Arizona Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love (ankle) suffered another setback during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory over the Dallas Cowboys, exiting late in the first quarter after his right ankle was rolled up on during a tackle. The rookie finished with 23 rushing yards on nine carries before heading to the medical tent and eventually the locker room. He was initially listed as questionable to return before being ruled out. Love had just returned after missing two games with a left ankle ...
news.title: Jeremiyah Love's Fantasy Outlook Clouded by Another Ankle Injury

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Keaton Mitchell has been an ambiguous fantasy asset this season. He's had games as the team's lead back and just as many as a non-factor in the offense. However, Mitchell could get a bye-week bump after Mike McDaniel got an extra week to scheme touches for him. He is a role-dependent player who can be an offensive weapon when schemed up correctly. Entering Week 8, Mitchell is RotoBaller's PPR RB47 in a tough matchup against the Los Angeles Rams. news.analysis: Mitchell turned in a career performance just one week after being blanked on the stat sheet. The 24-year-old found the end zone on a 12-yard reception in the second quarter and logged a team long 47-yard reception in the fourth quarter. Mitchell and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.contents: New York Jets wide receiver Adonai Mitchell caught seven of nine targets for a team-high 142 yards and one receiving touchdown during Sunday's Week 8 loss against the New York Jets. Mitchell was coming off a frustrating Week 7 performance in which he caught zero passes on a 44% snap share, but he bounced back in a huge way against Vegas by out-producing both Garrett Wilson and Omar Cooper Jr. Along the way, Mitchell handled a 60.9% snap share, which is more than the previous week but still ...

news.contents: Indianapolis Colts tight end Tyler Warren failed to impress during Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars. Warren continues to see a high target share, but he failed to do anything with it on Sunday. He hauled in four of his 10 targets for 18 yards during the blowout loss. The 24-year-old made his return to the field this week after two straight absences, and it looks like he didn't even show up. news.analysis: Fitzgerald has missed five PATs this season, but he remains a perfect 13-of-13 on FG tries with a long of 53 yards. The second-year kicker hit a 50-yard attempt on Thursday night and should be a decent fantasy option going forward.
news.contents: Ryan Fitzgerald made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.title: Ryan Fitzgerald puts seven points on the board Thursday night

news.contents: Tennessee Titans quarterback Cam Ward continues to struggle to establish himself as a fantasy option, having thrown for more than 200 yards just once through seven games while failing to record multiple passing touchdowns in any contest. Ward has been particularly disappointing in recent weeks, averaging under 7 fantasy points per game over his last 3 outings, the worst in the NFL. Those numbers would actually place him near WR45 over that time. Cincinnati presents a somewhat favorable matchup ...

Helm led the team in receiving yards on Sunday and set career highs with his yardage and target total. In fact, the former Texas Longhorn fell just three yards shy of matching his receiving total for the season in this game alone. It was a nice effort on a day that the team was short a receiving option in wideout Carnell Tate (shoulder). ...
